verdict.rationale: Open-sourcing its own code is a fair question for a SaaS MCP platform like Glama, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers third-party open-source servers in its catalog and building images from users' own GitHub repos. Nothing shows Glama's own source is published under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
